h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hubli Dharwad

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hubli Dharwad

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Hubli-Dharwad

c: Hubli and Dharwad are two different cities under one municipal corporation, and outdoor gym buyers in each are quite different. Dharwad is a university and school town, while Hubli is a trading and railway centre with growing housing layouts. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment across both, to universities, schools, colonies, offices and public parks. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 500 km away by road.

North Karnataka has hot summers and a moderate monsoon, so our machines face strong sun more often than heavy rain. The galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats are made for that. Fitting is done by our installation team or a dealer in south India, on grouted or self-standing bases. Tell us whether your site is a campus, a colony or a public park. The answer changes which machines we suggest, and we will send a layout drawing to match.

facts.value: About 500 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gym equipment to both Hubli and Dharwad?
items.a: Yes. We supply campuses, colonies, offices and parks in both cities. Orders for more than one site can travel in the same delivery from our Vasai factory.

items.q: Which machines suit a university ground?
items.a: Students prefer strength and training machines such as the Cross Fit frame, pull-up stations and chest press machines. Add one or two gentle machines for staff and visitors.

items.q: What warranty do the machines carry?
items.a: Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years, and springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year. It covers manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as per our instructions.
